verses.text: "Come, all you who are thirsty, come to the waters! You who have no money, come, buy and eat! Come, buy wine and milk without money and without cost.
Why spend your money on what is not food, and your hard work on what does not satisfy? Listen carefully to me, and eat what is good. Then you will enjoy the richest food.
Listen and come to me. Hear me, so that you may live. I will make an everlasting covenant with you, my faithful love promised to David.
Look, I made him a witness to the nations, a leader and commander of the peoples.
Look, you will call nations you do not know, and nations that do not know you will come running to you, because of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, for he has given you glory."
Look for the LORD while he can be found. Call on him while he is near.
Let the wicked leave their ways, and the evil leave their thoughts. Let them turn to the LORD, and he will have mercy on them. Let them turn to our God, for he will freely forgive.
"For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways," says the LORD.
"Just as the heavens are higher than the earth, so my ways are higher than your ways, and my thoughts higher than your thoughts.
The rain and snow come down from the sky and do not go back up without watering the earth. They make it grow and sprout, giving seed to the farmer and bread for people to eat.
In the same way, the word that comes from my mouth will not come back to me empty. It will do what I want, and it will succeed in the purpose for which I sent it.
You will go out with joy and be led out in peace. The mountains and hills will burst into song before you, and all the trees in the fields will clap their hands.
Instead of thorn bushes, cypress trees will grow. Instead of briers, myrtle trees will grow. This will bring honor to the LORD's name. It will be an everlasting sign that will never be destroyed."
